raw_text: This Modi-Xi handshake image is clearly AI-generated, likely Midjourney v5.2 based on the rendering style. Classic tells: look at the fingers — there are 6 on Modi's right hand, the tie knot has impossible geometry, and the background figures have that typical diffusion-model face melting. What's interesting is how quickly it spread as if it were real. My parents sent it to me on WhatsApp as 'breaking news.' This is exactly the kind of political deepfake imagery that's going to be a massive problem in the 2024 election cycles globally. The image has now been shared over 100K times on Twitter alone.
